seaIce.note: Broadband albedos of Arctic sea-ice surfaces, measured: snow 0.80-0.87, bare ice 0.5-0.7, ponds 0.2-0.4 (Perovich et al. 2002, SHEBA); nilas and grey ice 0.16-0.35 (Brandt et al. 2005). The visible band is bluer than the broadband mean.
